remarks: Fabulous Single-story Home in one of Brentwood most desirable neighborhoods. Offering 3 bedrooms with the possible of a 4th bedroom or office, 2 baths, over1400 sq feet. Fresh exterior and interior paint. Updated bathrooms with quartz surround and vanities. Newly landscaped yard. Water softener. Located just minutes to downtown, Vasco Road and the Bypass. Close to schools and shopping. This is move in ready.
